Beginner Guide: Why Passing on Options Here Protects Your Capital

Cheap implied volatility alone is never a reason to buy short-dated calls on an extended stock in a weak market. Paying $625 for a 52-day call spread right before a December 9 Analyst Day exposes 100% of your premium to time decay and a routine pullback toward the 200-day moving average ($221.81). Patience in cash until common shares pull back into $211.18–$223.49 offers superior risk-adjusted returns with zero expiration clock.
